mechanism: Both agents have CNS depressant effects and meprobamate may increase varenicline levels through CYP metabolism competition, while varenicline can potentiate meprobamate's sedative and neuropsychiatric effects.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, sedation, and neuropsychiatric symptoms; consider dose reduction of meprobamate or alternative anxiolytic; counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
